title: The owner's twelfth notes: the next seat's HUD only once the eye is on it, red MANUAL OVERRIDE calls to action, the early-close line, a day dial in the HUD, the flank probes off; the tank collision overhaul and SOL's reach answered as options
context: Owner, 2026-10-03 (on 2f312a8e): 1) the tank still bumps walls and now the gate in unnatural staccato, can unnatural bumps be detected and resolved with a forced move, what are the options; 1b) collision with walls, the half-open gate, narrow canyons and objects may need an overhaul, it got worse in the last updates; 2) entering the Quiver, its HUD shows before the player is in it; 3) early game: a large red call to action in the centre, e.g. ROTOR MANUAL OVERRIDE!, Isao's text stays at the bottom left; 4) the same, QUIVER MANUAL OVERRIDE!; 5) the early-close line: if you close it too early we lose biomass; 6) a minimalist day/night indicator in the HUD, a circle getting darker and brighter; 7) how is SOL managed on the first two manual passes, it seems impossible to move it to the antipode.
outcome: 2) The seat glide began with the hand-over shot and ran out in 1.4 s of a 5.6 s shot, so the new seat's panel, scope and spotting monitor showed mid-flight; the glide now waits while the takeControl shot flies (createSeatGlide wait) and the monitor is hidden with the rest. 3, 4) Every scripted seat hand-over calls '<SEAT> MANUAL OVERRIDE!' as a co-cta callout (red, 2.4x, held 2.6 s, kept when the praise is off), replacing the round-seven transfer line; Isao's panel keeps the explanation. 5) Sector 1's brief: 'Close one too early and we lose the biomass it would have paid.' 6) src/fx/daylight.js makeDial: a 16 px disc top centre lit by the daylight, warm at the golden hour, a tick going round its rim with the day. 1, 1b) Not overhauled yet: the eleventh notes' flank probes are off (TANK_WALL.width 0) as the likeliest cause of 'it got worse'; the options are written up for the owner to pick. 7) Answered, not changed.
alternatives: Hiding each seat's HUD in its own module during the hand-over: the body's seat-gliding class already hides them; holding the glide keeps one rule
Keeping the transfer line beside the call to action: two big lines at once is the clutter the CTA is meant to cut
evidence: scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --round7 (QUIVER MANUAL OVERRIDE! called; mid-flight the HUD and the spotting monitor stay hidden; the day dial in the HUD)
--round6, --story-world, --chapters and the default suite green (the default suite's Units missile step timed out once and passed on a rerun)
